fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Photographs, X-rays and a digital scan, then a treatment plan showing what will move, in what order, and roughly how long it will take.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Brackets are bonded to each tooth and a wire threaded through. Around an hour, and it doesn’t hurt - though the teeth will ache for a few days afterwards as pressure begins.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Every six to eight weeks the wire is changed or tightened to progress the movement. Each adjustment brings a day or two of tenderness.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Brackets are removed, adhesive polished off, and retainers fitted immediately - usually a fixed wire behind the front teeth, a removable retainer at night, or both.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Soft food for a few days after fitting and after each adjustment.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Avoid hard, sticky and chewy foods for the whole treatment - toffee, hard nuts, ice, crusty bread. They break brackets and add months.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Cut apples and carrots into pieces rather than biting into them.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Brush after every meal and use interdental brushes around the brackets. Braces make cleaning harder and decay risk higher.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Orthodontic wax over anything rubbing the cheek or lip.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Never cut a poking wire - reposition it gently or cover it with wax and ring us.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Wear a fitted mouthguard for any contact sport.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Come to every adjustment. Missed appointments are the main reason treatment overruns.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Stronger, smaller brackets, usually cheaper, and less prone to staining. The visible option, and still the workhorse of orthodontics.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Removable and even less visible, but they only work while worn and handle some movements less predictably.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For minor irregularity, bonding or veneers can create the appearance of alignment quickly - at the cost of enamel, and without fixing the underlying position.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: No treatment is risk-free, and you should hear this before you decide rather than afterwards.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Ceramic brackets are larger and more brittle than metal ones, so they break more easily and can add appointments and time.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: The elastic ties around the brackets stain with coffee, tea, red wine, curry and smoking. They’re changed at every adjustment, but they will discolour between visits.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Ceramic is harder than enamel, so brackets on lower teeth can wear the opposing upper teeth in some bites. We assess this before recommending them.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Treatment can be slightly slower than with metal braces, since more force must be applied cautiously.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: They cost more than metal braces.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Decalcification, permanent white marks around where brackets sat, is a real risk with poor cleaning, and it is not reversible.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Gum inflammation and swelling around brackets is common if hygiene slips.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Expect discomfort for a few days after fitting and each adjustment, and initial irritation to cheeks and lips.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Relapse without retention is certain. Retainers are for life in some form.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ceramic braces cost more than metal braces and are usually paid in instalments across treatment. Health funds with orthodontic cover typically contribute an annual amount, so treatment spanning two calendar years can attract two years of benefit. Payment plans are available (lending criteria, fees and T&Cs apply).

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Before anything starts you’ll have a written treatment plan with costs, inclusions and any conditions spelled out, plus an estimate of your health fund rebate checked at the desk.
